message.reasoning:
The user asks: "尋找從紐約到波士頓的最快路線。" (Find the fastest route from New York to Boston). This is not about primes; it's a request for directions or travel planning. There's no tool relevant here. We can respond with general advice.

We need to provide an answer. No tool usage needed. We'll give suggestions like driving via I-95 N, using Google Maps, etc., mention possible traffic conditions and alternative routes such as taking Amtrak train, flight options, bus services. Also maybe suggest checking real-time traffic data. Provide approximate distance (~215 miles) and typical drive time ~4 hours depending on traffic. Mention major highways: I-87 North then I-90 East? Actually NY to Boston typically uses I-95 N through Connecticut into Massachusetts. Or take I-84 east out of Hartford to Worcester then US Route 20/East? But main is I-95 N. So we will advise accordingly.

We'll also note potential detours due to construction, recommend leaving early morning to avoid rush hour. Suggest using navigation apps. Possibly mention tolls along I-95. And if they want public transport, mention Amtrak's Northeast Regional service between NYC Penn Station and Boston South Station takes around 3h45m. Bus options include Greyhound, Megabus, BoltBus. Flights exist but likely less convenient.

Thus produce helpful response.
